2. Negative Quantity on rows 5, 14, 65 (-2, -6, -3), violating the rule that Quantity must be a positive whole number (min 1) and producing negative Revenue — excluded those 3 rows.
3. Revenue ≠ Quantity × Price on rows 10, 19, 61 (e.g. 2400 vs expected 240) — recomputed Revenue = Quantity × Price on those rows per the rules file.

Caveats: 3 rows (36, 40, 49) have missing Region and were not assigned to any region (rules give no default, so no values were invented); one of them (row 36) is an Electronics row, so its $5,400 revenue is excluded from the regional totals. Date column has 3 invalid dates (rows 48, 50, 64), but Date is not used in this question, so they were left alone. No duplicate rows found.
